There must be other options.|attr=Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and Doctor Sionver Boll assure Doge Nakha Urus and Jedi Master Mace Windu about the safety of the electro-proton bomb|src=}} The '''Battle of Malastare''', one of the longest and fiercest engagements of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. Hostilities commenced when an [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|invasion force]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] assaulted the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world, which had [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] reservoirs necessary for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to maintain its offensive. After an extended [[Time/Legends|period]] of fighting, the battle appeared to conclude with a Separatist victory, so Republic [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] authorized the use of an untested [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], which was capable of deactivating technology by means of an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]]. As the Republic forces and Malastare's native [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] units occupied a final position near [[Doge/Legends|Doge]] [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]]' [[Doge's Palace|palace]], a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] dropped the electro-proton bomb on the advancing Confederate [[Droid/Legends|droid]] columns. The weapon successfully deactivated the enemy [[Army/Legends|army]], but it also created a sinkhole, which swallowed Republic men and equipment. Rescuers led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] discovered that a gargantuan creature—the [[Unidentified Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]]—had been awoken by the blast. Although the Dugs attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the beast, fearing that it would destroy their civilization, Palpatine desired to save the monster for possible experimenting, as its [[Armor/Legends|armor]] could not be penetrated by [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] or [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Eventually, a force of [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|stun tanks]] subdued the beast, which was then taken to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for study, and a [[Treaty of Malastare/Legends|treaty]] was signed with the Dugs, providing the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] with fuel. ==Prelude== {{Quote|We need that treaty signed, so we can gain access to the fuel reserves here on Malastare. Without it our armies shall be vulnerable.''"
"''I will do my best.|Republic Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and Dug leader Doge Nakha Urus|}} In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the rich natural [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] reserves''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]'' of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] became crucial for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], whose war effort would have suffered a severe setback without them. Therefore, [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''—who was secretly a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] called [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious{{DB|character|palpatine|Palpatine}}{{DB|character|darthsidious|Sidious, Darth}}—intended to secure the world. This made the planet a strategic target, as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was also interested in these natural resources. To ensure the fuel supply of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and prevent Malastare from joining the Separatists, Palpatine wished to sign a [[Treaty of Malastare/Legends|treaty]] with the [[Malastarian council/Legends|Malastarian council]]. The [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]]' leader, [[Doge/Legends|Doge]] [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]], headed this body, and, therefore, he and the council had control of the fuel reserves.{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/11946627956|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=The fuel reserves are not controlled by the Gran-led planetary government thus the need for a separate treaty with the Dugs.}} ==The battle== ===Beginning battle=== {{Quote|I won't allow my people to become Separatist slaves!|Doge [[Nakha Urus/Legends|Nakha Urus]]|}} After an extended [[Time/Legends|period]] of combat, the Confederacy's [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid units]] were on the verge of capturing Malastare. In an attempt to turn the tide of the battle, Palpatine authorized the Republic [[Army/Legends|Army]] to utilize a new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] called the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], which could release an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic wave]] capable of disabling [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and vehicles within its explosive radius. The weapon had never been tested before,{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news/zillobeast_weekly/index.html|text=A Giant Beast Unleashes Havoc on ''The Clone Wars''}} and Nakha Urus and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] initially feared the possibility of the weapon affecting Malastare's ecosystem. The pair eventually agreed to the deployment of the bomb at the urging of the Chancellor. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]], the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who developed the bomb, also assured the two that the weapon would impact neither the world nor its inhabitants negatively. [[File:Battle_of_Malastare.png|thumb|left|225px|Republic AT-TEs fire at and take incoming fire from Separatist forces.]] Meanwhile, a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Malastare)|T-series tactical droid]] led the Confederacy's invasion force—consisting of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]] supported by [[LR-57 combat droid/Legends|LR-57 combat droids]], [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]], [[LM-432 crab droid/Legends|LM-432 crab droids]], [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droid starfighters]], and [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]]—toward the [[Doge's Palace]], where Windu, Urus, Boll, and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were gathering. As [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], led by [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ponds/Legends|CC-6454]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], and supported by [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcers]] supplemented with Dug forces that included [[Dug cavalier/Legends|cavaliers]] riding [[Insectomorph/Legends|insectomorphs]] and [[Dug rail gun/Legends|artillery]], went on the defensive, several [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing bombers]] and [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170 starfighters]] escorted by [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] took off from the Doge's palace under orders from Skywalker. While the ARCs began strafing the Confederate army, the [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] carrying the superweapon—piloted by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]] "[[Goji/Legends|Goji]]," the leader of [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]]{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars (toy line)|packtype=2010 Basic Figure|pack=#28: Clone Trooper Pilot|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TCW28-CloneGoji.asp}}—maneuvered over the target area and dropped its load. The ensuing explosion and electromagnetic pulse damaged and deactivated the droid army, along with several Republic vehicles and pieces of technology. ===Zillo Beast=== {{Quote|The ground is sinking!|Jedi Master Mace Windu|}} The detonation of the bomb caused parts of the surface to collapse, creating a sinkhole. Several [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], AT-TEs, and [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] fell into the pit, which also damaged pipes coming from a fuel facility. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] dispatched search parties to retrieve the men, but contact was soon lost with them, so Urus, Windu, and Skywalker traveled to the hole in a gunship to investigate. Windu assigned Skywalker to Urus, while he and CC-0411 flew down the crater with a group of clone [[Troop/Legends|troopers]]. After finding some survivors, the Jedi Master continued his search with three clones, also calling Skywalker to the spot. [[File:Hello_beastie.jpg|thumb|right|225px|The rescuers are attacked by the Zillo Beast.]] When the surface they were standing on began to move, the team members realized they were standing atop a creature. The clones opened fire on the creature to no avail, as their [[DC-15|blasters]] could not pierce the beast's skin. The clones fell off the beast, which killed one trooper, but Skywalker arrived in [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|his starfighter]] and began circling around the monster's head to distract it. Windu and his escort were airlifted by an arriving [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] gunship, but Skywalker's [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] was damaged by the creature, causing the vehicle to crash. The Jedi Knight attempted to engage the beast, only to find that its skin was [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-resistant. Skywalker was forced to jump on [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], his [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]],''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' who used his [[Rocket booster/Legends|thruster jets]] to flee the scene. Urus later informed the Jedi that the creature was none other than the [[Unidentified Zillo Beast/Legends|last]] surviving [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]]—a ninety-seven-[[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long monster that used to prey on the ancestors of the Dugs before its [[Species/Legends|species]] was supposedly driven into extinction when the harvest of the fuel began. Soon, Dug [[Railgun/Legends|rail guns]] and [[Dug debris loader/Legends|debris loaders]] arrived and spent the rest of the day bombarding the beast, illuminating the sinkhole. The two Jedi quarreled with Urus on the matter, as the latter intended to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the creature due to the danger it presented to the Dugs, as a prophecy said that one of the creatures would eventually eradicate the Dug species. The Jedi stated that ending the life of the last member of a sentient species was against the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]], but the Dug leader did not allow interference into the subject, dubbing it an internal affair and threatening to reject the fuel reserve treaty if he was not allowed to kill the Zillo Beast with Republic support. This meant that he was using his position to enforce the Republic to accept it. Seeing that there was no hope in convincing the Doge, Windu and Skywalker left. [[File:StunTanksZilloBeast-TZB.png|thumb|left|225px|RX-200 ''Falchion''-class assault tanks fire on the Zillo Beast.]] The Jedi then contacted Chancellor Palpatine, showing him a [[Hologram/Legends|holorecording]] of the creature. Windu insisted that the beast be carried off-planet and settled in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], while Boll suggested further study of the monster due to the ability of its skin to resist most weaponry. Skywalker then proposed that the gaps in its [[Armor/Legends|armor]] be targeted with stun cannons, which would put the animal into an unconscious state similar to death. This would allow the Republic to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] the beast away and examine it and satisfy the Dugs as well. The Chancellor, amazed by the monster, accepted Skywalker's plan. Upon approaching Urus with [[RX-200 Falchion-class assault tank/Legends|stun tanks]], the Jedi found that the Dugs had already begun their operation; the sinkhole was being filled up with Malastarian fuel, which was said to be lethal to the creature. Windu attempted to convince Urus by threatening him with [[Mace Windu's lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]], but the Zillo Beast climbed out of the sinkhole, destroying the Dug rail guns set up around the perimeter. Seeing this turn of events, the stun [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] opened fire and eventually managed to daze the beast, albeit at the cost of several tanks. ==Aftermath== {{Quote|Welcome to the Republic, Doge Urus. I'm sure this business arrangement will be mutually beneficial.|Chancellor Palpatine, just after the treaty had been signed|}} [[File:Treaty_of_Malastare.png|thumb|right|220px|Doge Urus signs the Treaty of Malastare]] Although the victory was costly, and the battle was one of the longest and fiercest engagements of the Clone Wars, Urus was satisfied and signed the treaty, which provided the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic war machine]] with fuel necessary to continue its offensive. The unconscious beast was loaded onto transports after being airlifted by a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/carrier/Legends|LAAT/c]] gunships, but Palpatine and his [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]] altered the original plans—which would have had the monster transported to the Outer Rim Territories—and ordered the Zillo Beast transported to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city-planet]], so that its armor could be studied for possible use. The Chancellor tasked Windu and Skywalker with escorting the creature to Coruscant. Studies of the Zillo Beast on Coruscant found that its scales could not be removed without hurting or killing the creature. An angered Palpatine ordered Boll to kill it, but the beast [[Zillo Beast incident/Legends|broke free]] from the facility in which it was analyzed and wrought havoc on the planet. As the beast made its way to the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]], Palpatine, Skywalker, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], and R2-D2 attempted to flee on the Chancellor's [[H-2 executive shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. Their efforts to escape were foiled, however, when the Zillo Beast grabbed the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and attempted to kill the Chancellor, as it recognized him as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].{{SW|url=video/the-zillo-beast-strikes-back-episode-featurette|text="The Zillo Beast Strikes Back" Episode Featurette}} Skywalker, however, managed to cut the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] in two, thus allowing them to escape. Not long after, LAAT/i gunships arrived, which dropped Malastarian fuel bombs on the creature, killing it. As the lifeless body of the Zillo Beast was transported away, the Chancellor ordered Boll to clone the creature—a command that surprised her. The Confederacy also took notice of the Zillo Beast's destructive capabilities. Later in the war, the Confederacy covertly dispatched a number of heavily-[[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaked]] [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droid]] shuttles to Malastare, hoping to gather a sample of the Zillo Beast's [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] so that Confederate [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] could clone another and use it as a war beast. Most of the Confederate forces, however, were destroyed by a tribe of uncivilized Dugs, who honored the Zillo Beast as a [[Deity/Legends|deity]] and used the droid parts to build a large statue in the shape of the beast. After detecting the presence of Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on Malastare, the Republic dispatched Skywalker's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and Master [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], along with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of clone troopers, to [[Mission to Malastare (Clone Wars)|investigate]]. They found the scrap statue and were forced to fight both the Dugs and the remaining Confederate forces,{{TCWComicCite|6.19|Dug Out}} defeating both.{{TCWComicCite|6.20|Outgunned}} ==Behind the scenes== The battle made its debut in the eighteenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, titled "[[The Zillo Beast]]." It eventually received its official name in the next episode, "[[The Zillo Beast Strikes Back]]," and also made a non-[[canon]]ical appearance in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', serving as the game's epilogue.''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' In ''LEGO Star Wars'', the level depicting the Battle of Malastare is divided into two parts. The first part is one of the game's several real-time strategy levels, in which the Republic and the Confederacy battle on the surface. Both sides control a number of ground bases, which allow the controlling side to build defensive weapon emplacements and troop [[Barracks/Legends|barracks]] and to call vehicle reinforcements. The playable characters Windu, Skywalker, CC-0411, and CT-7567 are required to capture one of the enemy bases, which allows the Republic to build a targeting paddle for the electro-proton bomb. The second part of the level is the battle against the Zillo Beast. In order to unlock the option to call in RX-200 tanks, several ground cannons must be built first. After the player has deployed several tanks on the battlefield and has concentrated their fire on the Zillo Beast, the creature is knocked down. It tries to attack again but is calmed with a giant pacifier. The Zillo Beast is then carried away by an LAAT gunship, while another gunship carries a giant rattle, and clone troopers follow behind with an equally giant baby bottle. ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars:
